clusters.headline: Israel President Tasks Gadi Eisenkot With Forming New Government
aiSummaryBullets: President Isaac Herzog designated opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to attempt the formation of a new government.
The appointment follows recent elections that failed to provide a clear parliamentary majority for any candidate.

clusters.headline: Gadi Eisenkot Pursues Coalition Talks Following Israeli Elections
aiSummaryBullets: Gadi Eisenkot has been appointed to lead the formation of a new government following the recent Israeli elections.
Eisenkot indicated an openness to including the outgoing prime minister's party and some far-right allies in a coalition under his leadership.
